newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Nedcor hikes prime to 20.25 pct immediately.
newsitem.headline: Nedcor hikes prime to 20.25 pct immediately.

text.p: Nedcor Ltd announced on Thursday it would lift its prime overdraft rate by one percentage point to 20.25 percent with immediate effect.
The bank said it would also hike its home loan by the same margin to 20.00 percent with effect from Thursday for new and existing home loans.
Nedcor is the third bank to hike its prime overdraft rate after Standard Bank and Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd both hiked their lending rates by the same margin earlier in the day.
First National Bank, the last of South Africa's "big four" banks, said it would announce its decision on whether it would hike its rates or not early this afternoon.
The rate increases come after the Reserve Bank hiked its official lending rate by one point to 17 percent from Thursday.
